Create a production 2D game animation sprite sheet: exactly FOUR columns and THREE rows, 12 full-body ninja dog sprites total, transparent PNG 1024x768, equal invisible256x256 cells. Body silhouette, body size, back line, leg angles, tail position and equipment must be almost identical across the row. No running or leaping.
Style: original Naruto TV anime, clean dark ink contours, crisp flat cel-shaded planes, natural canine colors, navy-blue Leaf ninja vests with a small red spiral patch on side, silver Leaf-symbol forehead protectors on navy bands.
ROW0: SAME small squat beige pug with broad black muzzle, folded ears, short thick legs, tightly curled beige tail, navy vest in all four frames. Full-body side profile facingRIGHT, modest braced stance. Approximate silhouette height90px inside256px cell, width130px.

ROW2: SAME large muscular charcoal-gray mastiff with broad dark square muzzle, folded ears, thick long upward-curved tail, navy vest in all four frames. Full-body side profile facingRIGHT, modest braced stance. Approximate silhouette height150px,width190px.

All12 dogs faceRIGHT. Show all four whole paws, complete tail and ears. Maintain precisely consistent scale and proportions within each row. Keep the body pose identical and grounded in every frame; horizontal back, bent braced legs, muzzle about shoulderheight. Strong open-mouth readability in frame0 and frame1; muzzle unobscured.
Genuinely transparent alpha-zero background. No floor, ground shadow, background color, haze, drawn checkerboard, grid lines, text, labels, numbers, panels, borders, target, prey, held objects, blood, saliva, sparks, smoke, bite effects, human figures or scenery.
